collectible.title: Sunset Sushi Menu
collectible.subtitle: Wait, this isn't a coupon!
collectible.text:
"Tuns out I didn't have a coupon with me... But I do have this! It's a mock up of the menu at the Sushi place I work in. It's my own design, drawing and everything.
Turns out that once I tried new things like drawing, writing and image editing, I was actually kind of okay at them...? Sometimes, you just have to try."
collectible.unlock: Finish a game where Sunset loses.
